description_expanded: This beautiful Alys Beach Vacation Rental home is the first home completed in the newest section of Alys Beach. The home features four bedrooms, all with private baths. The inviting courtyard features a private pool and covered seating including an inviting swing. The first floor offers a large, open great room with ample seating and a half-bath. The kitchen is spacious with a large center island and a butler’s pantry. The dining area features built-in seating on three sides and can sit up to 10. The first floor also includes a bedroom with king-sized bed. The second floor offers the primary suite with a king-sized bed, another bedroom with a king-sized bed and the fourth bedroom with two double beds. The laundry room is also found on this level as well as a large patio with ample seating, a built-in grill and a firepit. Parking for this home is in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
